text:
mike_sales: Customer (MercuryPay) asked for reserved capacity quote. Traffic: steady 180 RPS chat, 700 RPS embeddings, short spikes to 1.1k RPS. Need chat p99 <300ms, embed p99 <200ms. They want reserved GPUs + burst credits + KMS. Any blockers?

elaine_sre: Quick clarifiers: avg tokens per chat? embedding dim? client batching?

mike_sales: Avg tokens ~50 in, 60 out. Embeds 1536-d. Clients sometimes batch ~8-12, not guaranteed.

vikram_se: For planning: recommend reserve for steady state (chat 180 + embed 350) and use burst credits for remaining embed capacity. With A100-eq, optimized fp16 chat ~45-55 RPS/GPU low-latency. Estimate baseline 6 GPUs reserved. Autoscale min=6, buffer=20%, max=18.

chris_infra: Suggest model mix: reserve fp16/quant-fp16, burst int8. Preheat KV cache 90-180min before go-live. Include synthetic warm script and 2-hour smoke test.

mike_sales: Pricing ask: what delta per GPU-hour reserved vs burst? Need numbers for their finance team.

elaine_sre: Back-of-envelope: on-demand~$3.00/GPU-hr => reserved ~$1.6-1.9/GPU-hr depending on contract. I'll prepare a short spreadsheet.

security-bot: KMS supported for Dedicated (AWS/GCP). Audit logs retention configurable. We'll need completed questionnaire to confirm key handling.

vikram_se: Embedding SLOs improve significantly if clients batch >=8 or use our batching proxy. Recommend enabling proxy if client batching inconsistent.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: int8 burst variant to staging (2 GPUs) on 2024-12-05T18:00Z.

mike_sales: I'll request expected daily burst hours and the completed security questionnaire from MercuryPay, and attach the reserve/burst cost calc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
